top_signals.title: US Natural Gas Inches Up on Colder Weather, Higher Flows to LNG
top_signals.summary: US natural gas futures increased slightly as forecasts shifted to show colder weather than previously expected across the eastern US, indicating higher demand for the furnace fuel as consumers crank up the heat. Gas flows to liquefied natural gas export terminals on the US Gulf Coast also rose, leaving less gas within the domestic market and adding upward pressure to prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
